# 越嚟越 + Adjective · *jyut6 lai4 jyut6 + Adjective*

**Meaning:** more and more … · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Degree and comparison

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fjyut6-lai4-jyut6).

越嚟越 before an adjective describes something that keeps increasing: hotter and hotter, better and better.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **天氣越嚟越熱。** |
| Jyutping | tin1 hei3 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 jit6. |
| Yale | tīn hei yuht làih yuht yiht. |
| Bopomofo | ㄊㄧㄣ¹ ㄏㄝㄧ³ ㄩㆵ⁶ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄩㆵ⁶ ㄧㆵ⁶. |
| English | The weather's getting hotter and hotter. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你嘅廣東話越嚟越好喇！** |
| Jyutping | nei5 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 hou2 laa3! |
| Yale | néih ge gwóng dūng wá yuht làih yuht hóu la! |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄍㄝ³ ㄍㄨㄛㄥ² ㄉㄨㄥ¹ ㄨㄚ² ㄩㆵ⁶ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄩㆵ⁶ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄌㄚ³! |
| English | Your Cantonese is getting better and better! |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **香港啲樓越嚟越貴。** |
| Jyutping | hoeng1 gong2 di1 lau2 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 gwai3. |
| Yale | hēung góng dī láu yuht làih yuht gwai. |
| Bopomofo | ㄏㆦㄥ¹ ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄉㄧ¹ ㄌㄜㄨ² ㄩㆵ⁶ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄩㆵ⁶ ㄍㄨㄜㄧ³. |
| English | Flats in Hong Kong are getting more and more expensive. |
